faq.a: Celal is associated with the Arabic form جَلَال, whose core sense is celal; majesty, splendour (turkish form).

faq.q: What is the origin of Celal?
faq.a: Celal is associated with Arabic. Celal is the Turkish form of Arabic جَلَال (Jalāl), meaning 'majesty, splendour'.
Yes — the underlying form جَلَال is Arabic.
Celal can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Celal should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. The root ج ل ل is Quranic, but Jalāl is not itself a Quranic personal name.

faq.a: In Urdu, Celal is rendered جلال and carries the sense جلال، عظمت.

faq.q: What does Celal mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Celal is rendered جلال and carries the sense جلال، شکوه.
A romanized syllable approximation is ce-lal. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Celal?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Celal, celal. Script forms are جلال, جَلَال, जलाल.

faq.q: Is Celal a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
